capabilities: Search the Streaming Availability API using the note title
Write movie details and streaming status as note properties
Refresh availability directly from tmdb_id and Type properties
Download poster images into the vault
Check a Jellyfin server for matching shows and watched status
extras: The API has free and paid tiers; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up where a movie or show is currently streaming and record that data on a note.

relations.evidence: using the Streaming Availability API by Movie of the Night

relations.evidence: User-configured Jellyfin server URL | Search Jellyfin libraries for matching shows

summary: Streaming lookup plugin that finds which services stream a movie or TV show and writes the results as note properties.
